title: Draw Me Nearer
lyrics: I am [C#m]Thine, O [A]Lord, I have [B]heard Your [E]voice,
But I [C#m]long to [A]rise in the [B]arms of [E]faith
There are great depths of love that I cannot know
There are heights of joy that I may not reach
'Till I rest in peace with Thee.
Consecrate me now to Your service, Lord,
By the power of grace divine;
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope
And my will be lost in Thine.
